findings.summary: The name lost its meaning and the year lost its shape.

evidence.baseline: the breath-and-spirit human, the pneuma within the human, brought to maturity through the seven initiates and the twelve tenets across fifty-two initiations. One initiation for each week of the year; one year to walk, for the first time, the whole path from Listening to Providence.
evidence.shipped: It sketches fifty-two weekly initiations across the Seven Initiates and Twelve Tenets. The name joins breath, spirit, and the human.

findings.diagnosis: The pneuma within the human is the gloss that makes the coined name readable, and joins breath, spirit, and the human is a list of ingredients rather than a meaning. For the first time is also the phrase that marks the year as a first passage rather than the whole path, which is the modesty CTD-0087 wants and the pass removed while adding a separate disclaimer.

BASELINE TEXT:

*The pne(h)uma(n) Curriculum*

With mentors gathered and trained, the work can be sequenced — and the sequence is a year. The year-long course of study is called the pne(h)uma(n) Curriculum: the breath-and-spirit human, the pneuma within the human, brought to maturity through the seven initiates and the twelve tenets across fifty-two initiations. One initiation for each week of the year; one year to walk, for the first time, the whole path from Listening to Providence.
